title: Copper To Netherite!
description:
Turns your copper items to netherite!
perfect for trolling!
body:
Copper blocks and item now look like netherite!

Copper Block: Netherite Block

Bamboo Block: Ancient Debris

Copper Ingot: Netherite Ingot

You can use it to troll your friends or whatever you want!

Have fun!
